description: Split 4x2: two independent sections, each splitting one polyphonic input across four outputs

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal split across the four outputs of the upper section, and across all eight when the lower input is unpatched; its lamp glows red when a channel could not be placed
The polyphonic signal split across the four outputs of the lower section; left unpatched, those four take the upper input instead. Its lamp glows red when a channel could not be placed

outputs.text: Carries one channel of its section's input, or as many as its own port menu is set to, from 1 to 16

menu: Channels, in an output's own port menu — how many channels of its section's input that output carries, 1 to 16
Restore mono outputs — puts all eight outputs back to one channel each
